catchment._source: guess: one nightclub ~ 2.5 pubs; 100 hotel rooms ~ 1 pub; a station ~ 2 pubs

demand._hour_source: mean of NTA time-of-last-trip bands Feb 2022, Feb 2024 (Fare Review 2024 p.36) and Feb 2026 (Consumer Survey p.25), % per hour; hours 00-04 belong to the previous evening's service day
demand._kernel_source: guess: a trigger counts from 45 min before (ramping to full at 15 min before, so a driver can arrive ahead of the crowd), stays full to 30 min after, gone by 60 min after
demand._venue_source: guess scaled to capacity: Aviva ~51k and Croke Park ~82k = 3; 3Arena ~13k = 1.5; RDS halls and League of Ireland grounds = 0.5
demand._weekday_source: NTA Taxi Consumer Survey 2026 p.23, day of most recent trip, Mon..Sun (%)

explain._source: guess (ADR 0013): display thresholds for 'Why this rank?' only; no score uses them

logger._autolog_source: ADR 0005 (Fable advisor rulings) — all guesses: 120 s exceeds most Dublin signal cycles; zone = 12 m + min(uncertainty, 15) of the kerb line, 10 m past the head to 1.5 x the stand behind the tail; creeps from Doppler speed (0.5 m/s bursts of 3-25 m) where reported, else approximate from a 30 s median (6 m held 20 s)
logger._depart_source: review fix: leaving needs 30 s outside the zone, or 10 s once 25 m beyond it, or > 60 m on a good fix, or reported speed > 4 m/s for 8 s; drift at rest stays near the zone
logger._gap_source: guess: a gap of more than 2 min between the last fix at the stand and the departure means the wait ended somewhere in the gap (end stamped at last sighting, censored)
logger._start_source: ADR 0006: Start detects the rank from the latest good fix (<= 30 s old): queue zone, else nearest within 75 m (tier C 40 m + GPS error), else 'not on Kerb's list' with up to 5 stands within 1 km for review

notes: Every number here is a guess until drivers log real waits (ADR 0002). Values are set only so that obvious extremes rank the right way (Task 6 tests), and each one is labelled with where it came from.

rank._source: guess: each km away halves-to-thirds a rank's appeal (score / (1 + km/k)); k=2 sent a Ballsbridge driver 3.4 km to Dame Street during an Aviva let-out. drive_kmh: guess: door-to-door city speed, used only to judge timed pulses and legality for when the driver would get there; calibrated from logged drives (ADR 0014). arrival: false switches back to judging at now

shift._source: ADR 0010 (Fable advisor rulings): idle_end_min 90 widens the NTA Taximeter Survey 2015 split at 70 min between hirings (Kerb sees less than a meter; a guess to calibrate); fatigue_h and fatigue_window_h from S.I. 33/2015 Reg. 40 (11 h with passengers in any one day, on 3 days running); active_move_m (2.5 x depart_far_m), resume_max_min, summary_show_h and max_shift_h are guesses

stats._source: guess: shorter / longer than usual = below 75% / above 125% of the stand's median (5+ waits) or the overall median (3+)
